name: Avian Rage
disable: DC 43 Nature check (master) to calm the birds, DC 45 Occultism check (master) to alter your aura, or DC 45 Performance check (master) to imitate the living
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any undead or creatures with void healing in the garden.
routine: (1 action) The birds swarm wildly through the garden, pecking and slashing at all undead creatures and creatures with void healing in the garden, dealing 3d10+20 slashing,1d10 bleed damage (DC 44 basic Reflex save).

items.name: Panic!
items.text:
Trigger An undead or a creature with void healing enters the garden

---

Effect The birds screech in panic, dealing 3d12+20 sonic damage to all creatures in the garden (DC 44 basic Fortitude save). On a failure, the creature becomes Stunned 1 (Stunned 3 on a critical failure). The trap then rolls initiative.

text: Hundreds of panicked whippoorwills swarm through the area.
